book.name: Markas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Markas liekhies hai

content: Bia tjhiete ke kaahaanie

Ekare baad Jiesoe phieno samoendar ke kienaare Parmeswar ke baat siekhaawe lagal. Aur etana dher manai aail soene kie oe ekgo bot me gail. Aisahie oe bot me baithal raha aur manai log kienaare thara raha.
Oe matlab ke kaahaanie kaam me leike oesab ke dher tjiedj siekhaawe lagal.
Aisane oe ie kaahaanie kahe lagal kie: „Thiek se soen. Ekgo khetiar raha. Ek rodj oe gail bia tjhiete.
Tjhietat me koetjh bia rasta par gier gail aur tjierai aaike khaai leis.
Tab koetjh bia gier paral djaaha thora se mattie aur nietje patthar raha. Hoewa par bia haldie se djam gail.
Bakie djab kara ghaam bhail, tab tjhota plansoe komalaaike mar gail. Oe plansoe ke sor to oeppare raha.
Koetjh bia gieral djaaha kaata waala djhalaasie ke bia bhie raha aur doeno sanghe djam gail. Tab kaata waala djhalaasie barhke ekwa ke dabaais. Aisane bhail kie barhia bia phal na deis.
Aur koetjh bia barhia djagaha par gieral aur djam gail, barka bhail aur phal deis. Kauno bia ties phal deis, kauno saathgo aur kauno saugo.”
Oe bolies: „Dje ke kaan hai, oke tjaahie soene ke aur na tel daarke baithe ke.”
Matlab ke kaahaanie ke biese me
Djab manai log tjal gail raha aur khaalie Jiesoe ke baara tjela aur ekaatgo doesar tjela batjal raha, tab sabhan ose poetjhies: „Ie kaahaanie ke matlab hamlog se bataai sakiehe?”
Tab oe bolies: „Pahiele Parmeswar koi se na bataais raha kie oe kaise raadj tjalaawe hai, bakie ab oe toelogke djanaawe hai. Aur doesarkwan khaalie matlab ke kaahaanie soenie.
Ie rakam se oesab taakie bakie na dekh paai. Aur oesab soenat rahie, bakie tabbo hamaar baat na samadjh paai. Djab aise na rahat tab oesab aapan paap pastaaike tjhama paai sakat.”
Bia tjhiete ke kaahaanie ke matlab
Oe bolies: „Djab toelog ie matlab ke kaahaanie na samadjh paawe hai, tab kaun waala samadjh paihe?
Attjha, ab ham toelogke samdjhaabe. Djaise ek khetiar aapan khet me bia tjhiete hai, oisane Parmeswar ke baat sagaro phailaawal dja hai.
Koetjh manai log ke diel djaise rasta hai djaun par bia gier gail. Djaise oesab khoes khabar soene hai, taise saitaan aaike baat me laat maare hai aur oesab khoes khabar ekdam se bhoelaai dja hai.

Koetjh doesar manai log ke diel djaise ek djagaha hai djaaha khaalie thora se mattie patthar par hai. Djab oesab Parmeswar ke khoes khabar soene hai, tab oesab toerant khoesiaalie se apanaai lewe hai.

Bakie oesabke bieswaas djaise ekgo oeppare djamal waala plansoe hai. Oesabke diel me baat ekdam se na samaail hai. Tab djab doesar log oesabke sataawe lagie aur oesabke doekh oethaawe ke parie, tab oesab halieje se aapan bieswaas tjhor dei.

Aur koetjh doesar log ke diel djaise ekgo djagaha hai djaaha kaata waala djhalaasie djame hai. Oesab khoes khabar soene hai, bakie rodj ke kaar-baar aur doenia ke dhan-daulat ke haahie aur bhie doesar tjiedj ke laalietj oesabke aur barhia lage hai. Aise oesabke bieswaas na barh sake hai aur niepata hoi djaai.

Bakie koetjh manai log ke diel djaise barhia djagaha hai. Oesab Parmeswar ke khoes khabar soene hai, tab oesab aapan diel me lei lewe hai, tab oelogke tjaal-tjalan attjha, kie to barhia, kie to bahoet biesaal hoi dja hai.”
Parmeswar ke baat par dhiaan lagaaw
Oe bhie bolies: „Djab raat ke ekgo tjieraag bariehe, tab oke thoro baltie se top deihe, kie to bedie ke nietje dhar deihe? Na, oke oeppar dhariehe.
Aisane ek dien sab tjhiepal kaam aur loekwaawal tjiedj dekhaai djaai.
Dje ke kaan hai, oke na tjaahie tel daarke baithe ke.”
Oe bolies: „Hamaar baat par dhiaan lagaaw. Djetana toe Parmeswar ke baat soeniehe, oe toke ese djaada samdjhaaiga.

Dje hamaar baat koetjh samdjhe hai, oe aur dher samdjhiega. Bakie dje kausies na kare hai hamaar baat samdjhe ke, aur sotje hai kie oe Parmeswar ke biese me djaan gail hai, oe ek dien dekhie kie oe koetjh na djaane hai.”
Parmeswar kaise raadj tjalaawe hai
Oe auro siekhaais kie: „Djab Parmeswar soeroe kare hai raadj tjalaawe ke, tab ie djaise ekgo khetiar hai djaun aapan khet me bia tjhiete hai.
Oe rodj soetke djaage hai aur aapan kaam-dhaam kare hai. Aur bia phoete hai, djame hai, tab phal dewe hai. Bakie khetiar na djaane hai ie sab kaise howe hai.
Tab djab phal pak djaaiga tab oe toerant hasoewa se katwaaiga.”
Sarso ke bia
Oe bolies: „Ham kaun rakam se toelog ke samdjhaai Parmeswar kaise raadj tjalaawe hai? Aur ham kaun kaahaanie kaam me laai?
Okar raadj me dja hai djaise ek sarso ke bia se howe hai. Oe sab se tjhota bia hai.
Bakie djab bowal dja hai, tab djame hai aur ek bahoet barka per howe hai. Aur barka daarhie howe hai kie tjierai oman khota lagaai sake hai.”
Jiesoe aisan kaahaanie kaam me laaike Parmeswar ke khoes khabar manai log se bataawat raha, djetana oesab samadjh paawat raha.
Oe khaalie kaahaanie se manai log ke Parmeswar ke baat siekhaawat raha. Bakie djab oe aapan tjela log ke saath akel rahat raha, tab oe sab kaahaanie ke matlab samdjhaawat raha.
Aandhie-toefaan
Oe dien djab derie hoi gail, tab Jiesoe aapan tjela log se bolies: „Aaw tjalie samoendar ke habara.”
Oe bot me raha. Tab oesab manai log ke tjhorke bot me djaaike okar sanghe tjal gail. Aur ekaatgo doesar bot bhie oelogke saath djaat raha.
Tab atjakke me aandhie-toefaan tjale lagal aur barka barka halfa maare lagal. Aur bot me etana dher paanie bhar gail kie doebe lagal.
Jiesoe paatjhe bot me ek takia par soetal raha. Tab sabhan oke djagaais aur bolies: „Maastar djie, dekh hamlogse ka howe hai. Toke na boedjha hai kie hamlog doebiela?”
Tab djab oe djaagal tab aandhie-toefaan ke daaties aur halfa se bolies: „Tjoep! Roek dja!” Aur aandhie-toefaan roek gail aur paanie ekdam dhiera hoi gail.
Tab oe aapan tjela log se bolies: „Toelog kaahe etana deraat rahiele? Toelogke bieswaas kaaha hai?”
Tab tjela log ie sab dekhke bahoet ghabaraai gail, aur apane me batiaai lagal: „Ie kaun rakam aadmie hai? Dekh, aandhie-toefaan aur halfa okar baat soen leis!”
